record.title: Password change and team reset do not invalidate access JWTs
record.description: Access tokens are stateless HS256 JWTs with no jti or server denylist. PATCH /auth/password and owner team-member reset update password_hash only. There is no logout. A stolen token remains valid until exp (default 30 days, max 90) after the password is changed. Account disable is checked at verification; password change is not.
record.claimed_root_cause: User has no token_version; password-change and reset paths never rotate or revoke outstanding JWTs, and user_from_access_token only checks signature, exp, user row, and Account.is_active.

trace.description: Authenticated password change rewrites password_hash and commits with no token revocation.
User columns have no token_version, jti list, or password_changed_at used at verify time.
Pre-change JWTs still decode and load the same User until exp as long as the account is active.

evidence.description: change_own_password sets password_hash and db.commit only.
reset_team_member_password also only hashes the new password.
create_access_token payload is sub, account_id, role, iat, exp; no jti or token_version.
Verification loads User by id+account_id; no password-epoch or denylist check.

blockers: OS-enforced sandbox and parent artifact promotion unavailable (empty allowlist env, no-network namespace, read-only target, trusted parent-side no-follow promotion); password-change-then-reuse of JWT A was not executed.
Whether a deployment adds an extra API-gateway JWT denylist is host-only and not source-visible.

validation_plan.local: In the OS sandbox on an isolated SQLite API, register a dummy owner and a dummy catalogger. Save JWT A from login. PATCH /auth/password as the owner, then GET /auth/me with JWT A (source predicts 200; intended revocation is 401). Repeat with the catalogger JWT after POST /team/members/{id}/reset-password. Confirm GET /auth/me still 403s when Account.is_active is false. Do not use production users.
validation_plan.deployment: Owner confirms production has no extra API gateway JWT denylist; do not test with live staff tokens.
